=== Mod-Shift-Enter inserts an empty sibling above and moves the cursor into it
--- given
- a
- b‸c
- d
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then
- a
- ‸
- bc
- d

=== Mod-Shift-Enter above a nested item keeps its indent and bullet
--- given
- a
    * b‸
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then
- a
    * ‸
    * b

=== Mod-Shift-Enter leaves the item's children with the item
--- given
- a‸
  - a1
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then
- ‸
- a
  - a1

=== Mod-Shift-Enter carries a task box over, unchecked
--- given
- [x] a‸
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then
- [ ] ‸
- [x] a

=== Mod-Shift-Enter renumbers an ordered list
--- given
1. a
2. b‸
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then
1. a
2. ‸
3. b

=== Mod-Shift-Enter from a notes line inserts above the owning item
--- given
- a
  no‸te
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then
- ‸
- a
  note

=== Mod-Shift-Enter with a selection passes to the editor
--- given
- ⟨a⟩
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then passthrough
- ⟨a⟩

=== Mod-Shift-Enter passes to the editor when the Enter behaviour is off
--- given enter=off
- a‸
--- when key Mod-Shift-Enter
--- then passthrough
- a‸

=== Insert above as a command works on a folded item
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  - a1
--- when command insert-above
--- then
- ‸
- a ⊟
  - a1
